entities.name: Q1PFE1 AIL1
observations: Exact sequence match to the analyzed 415-residue protein; reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana UniProt entry Q1PFE1.
Likely transcriptional activator that binds GCC-box pathogenesis-related promoter elements and participates in stress-responsive gene regulation.
Localized to the nucleus according to curated UniProt evidence.
Contains two AP2/ERF DNA-binding domains: AP2 PF00847 at residues 223–281 and 324–375.
Reported interactions include ANL2, HDG2, HDG10, and possibly GL2, HDG3, ATML1, and PDF2.

entities.name: AIL1 sequence properties
observations: Length 415 aa; calculated molecular weight 47,132.394 Da; theoretical pI 6.58; predicted charge at pH 7 is -2.73; GRAVY -0.8296; instability index 42.89.
Values are sequence-derived estimates and do not account for processing, post-translational modifications, ligands, or oligomerization.

entities.name: GCC-box stress transcription
observations: AIL1 is annotated as regulating DNA-templated transcription and binding transcription cis-regulatory regions, with a proposed role in stress-factor and stress-signaling gene regulation.
